beats.vo_text: Ye kahani kisi social media afwaah par nahi, balki Peshwa daftaron mein darj 30 August 1773 ki aadhi raat ka qatl par darj hai. Poona shahr ki aam shaam thi, jab mehal ke andar achanak mashalein bujha di gayin aur Gardi hathiyaron ke sath daudte hue ghuse. Lekin 1773 mein 18 saal ke Peshwa Narayanrao, Raghunathrao aur Gardi sainik Sumer Singh ke sath ek aisi ghatna ghati jisne is poore ilaaqe ki taqdeer badal di.

beats.vo_text: Jo log yahan se aadhi raat ko guzre hain, unhone bataya ki theek 12 bajte hi... Amavasya ki aadhi raat ko patthar ke farsh par khoon ke sookhe daag ubharte hain aur achanak hawa mein talwaron ke takrane ki metallic smell aati hai. Mobile phone ka battery percentage achanak zero ho jata hai aur tapman itna girta jaise aap kisi barfili ghaati mein khade hon.

beats.vo_text: Sabse khaufnaak hadsa tab report hua jab 18 saal ke peshwa ko uske apne chacha ke samne tukde-tukde kar diya gaya tha, aur pichle 250 saal se har full moon ko hazaaron logon ne wahi cheekh suni hai! Chashmadeedo ke mutabiq unhone deewar par dekha ki sadiyon purana ek saya bina zameen ko chhue tezi se unki taraf badh raha tha! Unhone cheekh kar kaha: 'काका मला वाचवा! (Kaka Mala Vachva — Chacha mujhe bacha lo!)' — aur unke paas wahan se bhaagne ke siva koi rasta nahi bacha tha!
